# Endgame Tier List for Last Epoch Season 5 - Rage of the Frostborn

by MaxrollSeason 5 - Rage of the FrostbornLast Updated: October 7, 2026

### Advertisement

This website is supported by ads.

This Tier List defines the performance of all builds against any high-end challenges, taking into account all their strengths and weaknesses, such as Damage, Defense, Speed, Gear Requirements and Ease of Play. Builds are compared based on their Endgame Planner Setup. The best ones stand in S Tier and are expected to outperform others. Choose wisely, read the guides and defeat all content!

Endgame build guides assume you have a Level 80 Character. To get there, level up with our Leveling Guides.

Corruption

All builds on Maxroll can push high Corruption, but some are better than others. Once a build no longer meets our standards, it gets archived. All builds displayed here are viable options.
